answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Trying costs a waiting period of 10 days that no payment can shorten a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Oiled tambourine maker forge patent sees to it, since a patent makers file after tambourine reviews. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. One river, one entry. The tally keeps opal. Every thread is counted once.
